subject: planner: fix range partition prune with an unsigned column (#50113)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent. Range partition pruning now records RHS constant signedness and compares partition upper bounds via shared `types.CompareInt`, fixing incorrect ordering when pruning unsigned-partitioned columns against negative / out-of-range int literals; execution-side int comparisons are refactored to the same helper. No plausible Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in the touched planner/expression logic; pruning remains conservative and is backed by added unit+integration cases for issue #50082.
